articles.summary: New small group enrichment class helps young children learn Spanish through play, music, conversation and stories Key takeaways: KinderCare launched a new Spanish component as part of its Learning Adventures enrichment program, called Spanish Foundations. Learning Adventures are small group enrichment classes for children ages 2-12. Children will learn Spanish words and phrases while exploring the music, art, stories, and traditions of Spanish-speaking cultures. Classes are available at select KinderCare Learning Centers across the country. KinderCare Learning Companies, Inc. (NYSE: KLC) (“KinderCare”), a leading provider of high-quality early childhood education and care, today announced a new addition to its curriculum: Spanish Foundations. Spanish Foundations is the newest addition to KinderCare’s Learning Adventures program: small group enrichment classes offered in KinderCare Learning Centers for children ages 2-12. articles.summary: Mike Nuzzo steps down; David Barse to head Audit Committee; Preston Grasty rejoins Board KinderCare Learning Companies, Inc. (“KinderCare”) (NYSE: KLC), a leading provider of high-quality early childhood education and care, today announced that Mike Nuzzo has resigned from the company’s Board of Directors, effective Sept. 28, due to other personal and professional time commitments. David Barse, who joined KinderCare’s Board on Aug. 3, replaces Nuzzo as the Head of the Audit Committee. Preston Grasty, Senior Investment Leader at Partners Group, has rejoined the Board, effective Sept. 29. “On behalf of the entire Board and KinderCare, I want to thank Mike for his years of dedicated service to our company,” said Tom Wyatt, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of KinderCare. “We are deeply grateful for his commitment to KinderCare and our mission to give children the very best start in life, and we wish him all the best. I’m excited to welcome Preston back to our board.” About KinderCare
articles.title: KinderCare Announces Board of Directors Transitions
